discovery.scispace_question: Which original research papers derive entropy-based adaptive angular moment or mesh methods for radiative transfer and precondition maximum-entropy moment closure using its Fisher or entropy Hessian?
discovery.exa_query: Primary research on entropy stable finite volume adaptive angular meshes for kinetic equations, goal oriented error using relative entropy, and entropy based moment closure Fisher Hessian preconditioning
discovery.policy: Search results used for discovery; adopted external claims linked to primary papers. No global novelty claim.

sources.title: Adaptive change of basis in entropy-based moment closures for linear kinetic equations
sources.use: Prior entropy-Hessian basis conditioning; present work uses analytic spherical rank-wise thermal-chemical blocks and explicit susceptibility comparison.

sources.title: Goal-based angular adaptivity for Boltzmann transport in the presence of ray-effects
sources.use: Unresolved angular transport structures can invalidate an error indicator's practical detection ability; finite-grid entropy certificates do not certify missing continuum rays.

sources.title: On Data-Processing and Majorization Inequalities for f-Divergences with Applications
sources.use: Data-processing context. Needed finite-state Hellinger contraction and Poisson inequality are explicitly derived in the report.

sources.title: A tensor formalism for transfer and Compton scattering of polarized light
sources.use: Screen-projected coherency scattering; equations 160 and 168 inspected by collision researcher. New small-matrix action derived and checked independently.
